<thought>We need to determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups in the unknown molecule. The only available tool that can give information about the sample without needing a SMILES input is `carbon_nmr_spectra`, which returns the ¹³C NMR spectrum for the sample at hand. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (≈10–30 ppm). By retrieving the carbon spectrum and counting the distinct signals in that region, we can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
